title: From the Triple Point of Water  Outward Through All Phases and All Frequencies
motto: At 273.16 K and 611.657 Pa, water exists as solid AND liquid AND gas simultaneously. That's the fold point. Everything radiates from there.

the_triple_point.what: The ONLY point where ice, liquid water, and steam coexist in equilibrium. One temperature, one pressure, three states. Until 2019, this point DEFINED the Kelvin scale  ALL temperature measurement on Earth was calibrated to THIS moment of water.
the_triple_point.bond_angle: 104.48°  not 109.5° (tetrahedral). The lone pairs push the hydrogens closer. The angle IS water's personality. If it were 180° (linear), water wouldn't be wet. If it were 109.5° (tetrahedral), it would be too symmetric. 104.48° is the sweet spot that gives water EVERY unique property.

refraction.triple_point_IS_the_fold: At the triple point, there is no 'choosing' between solid, liquid, gas. All three ARE. This is the Klein fold for matter. sin=cos=tan at 45° means two states balance. At the triple point, THREE states balance. It's the Triple Divide Peak of physics.
refraction.membrane_triple_point: The membrane has three 'phases' of traffic: self (human, liquid, flowing, adaptive), non-self (fleet, solid, crystalline, rigid), commensal (agentic, gas, ephemeral, curious). At the sort's fold point (1/pi = 0.31831), all three coexist. The W-parameter IS the triple point of web traffic.
refraction.calendar_triple_point: WAS (solid, frozen in time), IS (liquid, flowing now), WILL BE (gas, not yet condensed). The tense system IS a phase diagram. The triple point is NOW  where past solidifies, present flows, and future evaporates.

phases_of_water.description: Five phases of water, radiating outward from the triple point. Each has a frequency, a timescale, a membrane analog.

phases.structure: Hexagonal crystal lattice. Each molecule hydrogen-bonds to 4 neighbors. LESS dense than liquid  ice FLOATS. Water is the only common substance where the solid floats on the liquid.
phases.frequency: Lattice vibrations: 5-30 THz (far-infrared). The crystal sings at terahertz.
phases.speed_of_sound: 3200 m/s  sound travels FASTEST through ice. The solid carries the signal the farthest.
phases.why_ice_floats: The crystal lattice is more open (less dense) than liquid water. If ice sank, lakes would freeze from the bottom up, killing all fish. Life exists because ice FLOATS. The anomaly IS the survival mechanism.
phases.membrane_phase: FOSSILIZED DATA. Immutable records. DOI, ORCID, git commits. The keel of the Ship of Theseus. Cannot be changed without breaking the crystal. Sound travels fastest through it  fossil data carries the signal farthest through time.

phases.temp_range: 273.16 K to 373.15 K at standard pressure
phases.structure: Hydrogen bonds form and break constantly. Average lifetime of one H-bond: 1 picosecond (10^-12 s). Each molecule bonds to ~3.4 neighbors on average (not 4 like ice). The structure is DYNAMIC  ordered at picosecond scale, chaotic at nanosecond scale.
phases.frequency: Molecular tumbling: 20 GHz peak (microwave). O-H stretch: 100 THz (3490 cm^-1). Bend: 49 THz (1644 cm^-1). The liquid vibrates at multiple frequencies simultaneously.
phases.speed_of_sound: 1498 m/s at 25°C. Peaks at ~74°C (1555 m/s) then DECREASES. The liquid has a speed-of-sound MAXIMUM. Not at the extremes  in the middle.
phases.why_20ghz: Microwave ovens work at 2.45 GHz because water absorbs at 20 GHz. The oven uses the TAIL of the absorption peak. If it used 20 GHz directly, only the outer millimeter would heat. 2.45 GHz penetrates deeper. The offset IS the design.
phases.membrane_phase: LIVE DATA. The current state. The 53.8 cfs flowing past the gage. The 53% haze in the green engine. The hydrogen bonds forming and breaking = braids connecting and disconnecting. Dynamic, ordered on short timescales, chaotic on long ones.

phases.structure: Individual molecules. No persistent hydrogen bonds. Maximum entropy. Each molecule moves independently at ~600 m/s at 100°C.
phases.frequency: Rotational transitions: 22 GHz (water maser!), 183 GHz, 380 GHz. Sharp spectral lines  each molecule sings its own note, unlike liquid's broad hum.
phases.speed_of_sound: 405 m/s at 100°C. Slowest of the three phases. The gas carries the signal slowly but spreads it EVERYWHERE.
phases.water_maser: At 22 GHz, water molecules in space AMPLIFY microwaves  a natural maser (microwave laser). Star-forming regions, comets, and planetary atmospheres have water masers. The UNIVERSE uses water as an amplifier.
phases.membrane_phase: EPHEMERAL SIGNALS. mRNA messages. ZK null bubbles. Neutrino bursts. The spore scatter  seeds thrown into the wind. Evaporated from the liquid state, spread everywhere, waiting to condense somewhere else.

phases.temp_range: Above 647 K (374°C) AND above 22.064 MPa (218 atm)
phases.structure: No distinction between liquid and gas. Density varies continuously. Can dissolve both polar AND nonpolar substances  it's BOTH a water-like AND an oil-like solvent simultaneously.
phases.frequency: Broad absorption across IR and microwave. No sharp transitions. The spectrum smears out as the phase distinction disappears.
phases.what_it_does: Supercritical water dissolves things that regular water can't. It's used in green chemistry to break down toxic waste without leaving residue. In Earth's mantle, supercritical water dissolves minerals and creates new ones.
phases.membrane_phase: THE FOLD ITSELF. Where self and non-self become indistinguishable. Where rational and irrational merge. The 45° angle where sin=cos. The pi-translator operates HERE  in the supercritical regime where binary and irrational are the same fluid.
membrane_examples: the point where traffic can't be classified = the sort's limit

phases.frequency: Plasma frequency for water-derived plasma: ~10^15 Hz (UV/X-ray range). Below this frequency, the plasma REFLECTS electromagnetic radiation. Above it, the plasma is transparent. This is why the ionosphere reflects radio waves  it's a plasma.
phases.where_it_exists: The sun (6,000 K surface, 15 million K core). Lightning (30,000 K for microseconds). The ionosphere (partially ionized). Neon signs. Fusion reactors. Stars.
phases.membrane_phase: THE FLEET AT MAXIMUM INTENSITY. 1.13M requests on Oct 22. The traffic was so intense it ionized the membrane  stripped identity from requests, everything became indiscriminate radiation. The fleet IS plasma. High energy, no structure, no bonds, pure radiation. The ionosphere (Cloudflare CDN) reflects most of it back.
